title: ContextCrate
description: Metrics for ContextCrate grouped by topic: MCP, search, embeddings, reranking, LLM, answers, query transformation, answer timing, ingestion, API keys, content popularity and runtime. Most panels follow the Crate selector.

panels.title: Indexed documents
panels.description: Current document versions across all crates

panels.title: Dead-lettered work
panels.description: Work items that exhausted their retries

panels.title: 🔌 MCP — tool usage, outcomes and latency (Crate selector)
Empty search ratio (1h)
panels.description: Share of search_crate calls that returned no passages — a sign of content gaps

panels.title: MCP tool calls by outcome
panels.description: ok / tool_error / denied / unresolved_crate / error

panels.title: 🔎 Search — retrieval latency and result quality (Crate selector)
Reranker effect: original top hit's new position
panels.description: 0 means the reranker agrees with retrieval; higher values mean it reorders heavily

panels.title: 🤖 LLM — requests, latency and provider errors (Crate selector)
LLM time to first token (p50 / p95)
LLM requests
panels.description: purpose: grade (relevance grading), answer, verify, revise

panels.title: 🎯 Answers — grading, sources and verification (Crate selector)
Grading: share of candidate chunks kept
panels.description: Low values mean retrieval returns many chunks the LLM grader rejects

panels.title: Answer verification results
panels.description: verified / unsupported / revised / blocked / unavailable / disabled

panels.title: Answers using transformation (1h)
panels.description: Share of answers whose retrieval used at least one transformed query

panels.title: Avg transformation overhead (1h)
panels.description: Time spent in model calls before retrieval, per question where the feature ran

panels.title: Avg queries searched (1h)
panels.description: 1 means the question was searched unchanged

panels.title: Step failure rate (1h)
panels.description: Strategy model calls that failed or returned nothing usable (fail-open: the question is still answered)

panels.title: Strategies used (selected range)
panels.description: Successful strategy calls. “auto” is the classification call of Auto mode.

panels.title: Applied strategy combinations (selected range)
panels.description: Which strategies actually changed the query set for a question. “none” = searched unchanged.

panels.title: Auto vs fixed selection (selected range)
panels.description: auto = chosen by the model, fixed = configured on the crate

panels.title: Strategy outcomes
panels.description: ok / failed / skipped (skipped = feature on but the answer model unavailable)

panels.title: Strategy statistics (selected range)
panels.description: Per strategy: how often it ran, how it ended, how long the model call took and how many queries it produced

panels.title: Strategy model-call time (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Duration of the single model call each strategy (or the Auto classifier) makes

panels.title: Transformation overhead per question (p50 / p95)
panels.description: All strategy calls of one question together, i.e. what the user waits before retrieval starts

panels.title: Queries generated per strategy (avg)
panels.description: rewrite and step-back always produce 1; sub-queries produce 2-4

panels.title: Queries searched per question
panels.description: After de-duplication; at most 6

panels.title: ⏱️ Answer timing — where the time goes (Crate selector)
Avg answer generation (1h)
panels.description: Streaming the answer from the model, excluding retrieval and verification

panels.title: Avg total answer time (1h)
panels.description: generate(): answer streaming plus verification/revision. Retrieval and transformation happen earlier, in prepare.

panels.title: Where the time goes (avg seconds per answer)
panels.description: Rough latency budget per answer. Divides each stage's total time by the number of prepared answers, so stages that only run sometimes (e.g. transformation) show their average impact.

panels.title: Total answer time (p50 / p95)
panels.description: generate(): answer streaming plus verification and revision

panels.title: Retrieval time: transformed vs unchanged (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Searching all queries plus fusion. More queries mean more searches.

panels.title: Prepare time (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Everything before the model starts answering: transformation, retrieval, grading

panels.title: Answer generation time (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Streaming the answer from the model

panels.title: Time to first token (p50 / p95)
panels.description: Measured from the start of the answer model call; it does not include prepare time

panels.title: Pipeline queue depth by stage
panels.description: Pending work items waiting for a worker

panels.title: Ingested documents
panels.description: new / updated / unchanged document versions found by the parser

panels.title: Images: kept, skipped and described
panels.description: Image filter decisions and vision descriptions per second (crate selector applies)

panels.title: API key requests by key
panels.description: Key names are bounded; keys beyond the limit are grouped as “other”

panels.title: API key authentication
panels.description: ok / invalid (unknown token) / revoked

panels.title: API key requests by key type
📚 Content popularity — what gets requested (Crate selector)
Most requested documents
panels.description: Top documents returned by search_crate / ask_crate or opened with fetch_document. Bounded to the top N per crate.

panels.title: Most requested chunks
panels.description: Individual passages returned most often

panels.title: Most used sources
panels.description: Sources (websites / repositories) whose content is returned most often

panels.title: Hits on the hottest documents
panels.description: Cumulative hits (persisted)
